_meta.about: Precision rune numbers. *_lo/*_hi are level 1 / level 18 values on the growth curve.

Press the Attack.note: Wiki: 40 + (160-40)/17 per level, linear. v4 used 40-174.12 on the growth curve (174.12 is the level-20 value).

Lethal Tempo.note: Ranged: 6 x 0.8 = 4.8% AS per stack; bolt (9 + 21/17 per level) x 0.667, linear, +1% per 1% bonus AS. v4 used 6-21.66 on the growth curve (21.66 is the level-20 value).

Conqueror.note: Wiki: ranged 1 stack per on-hit attack; 2 stacks for ability damage once per 4 s per cast instance (each Pierce is a new cast, 9 s cooldown). Per stack 1.8-4 adaptive, linear (AD = 60%). v4 used 1.8-4.26 on the growth curve.

Fleet Footwork.note: Ranged: 60% of 15-160 on the growth curve (9-96), + 6% bonus AD + 3% AP. 109.64 is the level-20 value, not a disagreement.

Bloodline.note: The model's 0-10 legend scale maps to 0-15 Bloodline stacks.
